purpose: Verify an employee can submit a valid indent and the system assigns ID, timestamp, audit entry, stored version, stock check and notification
preconditions: Employee authenticated and authorized to create indents; no similar existing indent
action_or_input: Create indent with item details, quantity, estimated cost and justification; submit
expected_result: Indent is in Submitted state with unique indent ID, submission timestamp, audit entry and stored submitted version; departmental/central stock check initiated; submission notification sent

purpose: Verify submission is blocked when mandatory information is missing
preconditions: Employee authenticated and authorized
action_or_input: Submit an indent with a mandatory field (e.g., justification) omitted
expected_result: Submission blocked; missing field identified; no indent ID/submitted indent created

purpose: Verify a potential duplicate is flagged for Department Admin review without automatic merge/cancel
preconditions: An existing indent with the same likely-duplicate details exists
action_or_input: Submit a new indent with similar item/quantity details
expected_result: New indent is still submitted and traceably flagged as potential duplicate for Department Admin review; neither indent is merged or cancelled

purpose: Verify requestor is informed when requested item exists in system stock
preconditions: Requested item has stock in system stock records
action_or_input: Submit indent for the in-stock item
expected_result: Requestor is informed the item is present in stock records; indent may proceed toward internal fulfilment

purpose: Verify requestor can confirm receipt and the system timestamps, audits, permits posting and notifies
preconditions: Active indent/issue/PO with delivery recorded; receipt accepted; no unresolved discrepancy
action_or_input: Requestor opens delivery record and records receipt confirmation
expected_result: Confirmation timestamped and audited; final stock posting permitted; stakeholders notified; confirmation available to Accounts for payment eligibility

purpose: Verify partial receipt confirms only accepted portion and keeps remainder open
preconditions: Delivery recorded with fewer units than ordered
action_or_input: Requestor confirms the accepted partial quantity
expected_result: Only accepted portion is confirmed; remaining quantity stays open per BR-PSM-022

purpose: Verify discrepant goods are routed to discrepancy recording rather than confirmed as accepted
preconditions: Delivery has damage/shortage/wrong item
action_or_input: Requestor reports discrepancy instead of confirming the discrepant portion
expected_result: Discrepancy recorded via PSM-UC-020; discrepant portion not finally accepted; final posting/payment remain gated

purpose: Verify requestor sees current state, milestones, audit history, hold/discrepancy status and notifications of own indent
preconditions: Indent exists and employee authorized to view it; notifications generated
action_or_input: Employee selects the indent in My Requests
expected_result: Current lifecycle state, key milestones, authorized audit/history, visible hold/discrepancy status and generated lifecycle notifications displayed; no data changed

purpose: Verify role-restricted information is omitted
preconditions: Indent has history entries restricted from the employee role
action_or_input: Employee views the indent status
expected_result: Restricted information omitted per BR-PSM-020; permitted information shown

purpose: Verify status reflects active SLA reminder/escalation or discrepancy without exposing unauthorized info
preconditions: Indent has an active SLA escalation or open discrepancy
action_or_input: Employee views the indent status
expected_result: Status reflects the SLA/discrepancy state; no unauthorized information exposed

purpose: Verify withdraw/cancel succeeds in a permissible state
preconditions: Employee is requestor of an indent in a state permitting withdrawal/cancellation
action_or_input: Select Withdraw (or Cancel) and confirm
expected_result: Indent changes to withdrawn/cancelled state; audit trail entry recorded; relevant stakeholders notified

purpose: Verify withdraw/cancel is blocked in a non-permissible state
preconditions: Indent in a state not permitting withdraw/cancel
action_or_input: Employee attempts Withdraw/Cancel
expected_result: Action blocked; indent state unchanged

purpose: Verify stock display, allocable availability and reservation when stock sufficient
preconditions: Indent exists; sufficient departmental/central stock with some existing reservations
action_or_input: Department Admin opens stock view and reserves required quantity
expected_result: Departmental/central stock and reservations displayed; allocable availability computed; reservation recorded and allocable availability reduced

purpose: Verify indent is marked for external procurement when stock is insufficient
preconditions: Indent exists; allocable stock is zero/insufficient
action_or_input: Department Admin opens stock view for the indent
expected_result: Indent marked for external procurement progression; no reservation made

purpose: Verify partial availability result is recorded without assumed split fulfilment
preconditions: Only part of requested quantity is allocable
action_or_input: Department Admin checks stock
expected_result: Stock result recorded showing partial availability; no split-fulfilment is applied automatically

purpose: Verify check cannot complete when stock records unavailable
preconditions: Stock records unavailable
action_or_input: Department Admin attempts stock check/reserve
expected_result: Check not completed; indent remains pending review; no reservation made

purpose: Verify authorized stock adjustment is posted and audited
preconditions: Accepted source event and authorization recorded; user has stock-adjustment permission
action_or_input: Department Admin selects item/location and source event, records adjustment with reason/reference
expected_result: Role and source-event consistency validated; adjustment posted to ledger; audit entry recorded

purpose: Verify posting is blocked when linked to unresolved discrepancy
preconditions: Adjustment’s source event has unresolved discrepancy
action_or_input: Attempt to post the adjustment
expected_result: Final posting blocked per BR-PSM-009/026; stock unchanged

purpose: Verify adjustment blocked without authorization
preconditions: User lacks stock-adjustment authorization
action_or_input: Attempt to record an adjustment
expected_result: Adjustment blocked per BR-PSM-020; stock unchanged

purpose: Verify picking and dispatch of reserved stock for approved internal issue
preconditions: Stock reserved; internal issue approved
action_or_input: Department Admin schedules picking and records dispatch/readiness for collection
expected_result: Issue state updated; reservation retained until receipt/posting point; action logged; requestor alerted

purpose: Verify issue cannot proceed when reserved stock no longer allocable
preconditions: Reservation invalidated by a verified inventory correction
action_or_input: Department Admin attempts to process the issue
expected_result: Issue cannot proceed; indent returns to stock/procurement review; no dispatch state recorded

purpose: Verify report generation, export and logging
preconditions: User has report access; data available
action_or_input: Select operational/procurement/stock report, supply supported filters, generate and export
expected_result: Report generated per filters; export available; report generation event logged

purpose: Verify unauthorized report access denied
preconditions: User lacks access to the report/data set
action_or_input: Request the report
expected_result: Access denied per BR-PSM-020/024; no report exposed

purpose: Verify Department Admin approves for external path, records criticality and routing
preconditions: Submitted indent in review queue; stock insufficient
action_or_input: Department Admin reviews duplicate flag and stock result, records criticality/priority, approves for next approval step
expected_result: Criticality recorded; indent routed per BR-PSM-004/014; decision recorded

purpose: Verify approval for internal issue when stock sufficient
preconditions: Submitted indent; sufficient stock available
action_or_input: Department Admin approves indent for internal issue
expected_result: Indent approved for internal issue; decision recorded

purpose: Verify rejection requires justification
preconditions: Submitted indent in review queue
action_or_input: Department Admin rejects with justification; also attempt rejection without justification
expected_result: Rejection with justification is recorded and auditable; rejection without justification is refused and indent remains pending

purpose: Verify potential duplicate is reviewed, not automatically cancelled
preconditions: Indent flagged as potential duplicate
action_or_input: Department Admin opens indent for review
expected_result: Indent remains active for admin decision; not automatically cancelled

purpose: Verify Director/Registrar approval routes to PS Admin and records decision and notifications
preconditions: Indent routed for final review; prior reviews complete
action_or_input: Director/Registrar opens indent and approves
expected_result: Approved procurement routed to PS Admin for tender/PO execution; decision recorded; notifications sent

purpose: Verify rejection requires justification and sets Rejected state
preconditions: Indent routed for final review
action_or_input: Director/Registrar rejects with justification; also attempt without justification
expected_result: With justification indent enters Rejected state; without justification rejection is not accepted

purpose: Verify three-way match verifies invoice and updates status, including eligible portion for partial receipt
preconditions: PO and GRN exist; invoice matches; verified vendor
action_or_input: Accounts Admin opens invoice with linked PO/GRN and records verification
expected_result: Invoice marked verified for eligible amount (partial per BR-PSM-022 where applicable); status updated; action recorded

purpose: Verify mismatched invoice placed on hold
preconditions: Invoice quantity/amount differs from PO/GRN
action_or_input: Accounts Admin attempts verification
expected_result: Invoice placed on hold with reason per BR-PSM-018; no payment eligibility created

purpose: Verify invoice for invalid vendor cannot proceed to payment
preconditions: Vendor not verified
action_or_input: Attempt to verify/progress invoice
expected_result: Invoice cannot proceed to payment per BR-PSM-012

purpose: Verify audit scope retrieval, output generation and access logging
preconditions: Auditor has authorized scope
action_or_input: Select audit scope and generate/export audit output
expected_result: Indents, approvals, procurement decisions, stock/GRN, invoices, payments and audit history retrieved; output available; audit/report access logged

purpose: Verify unauthorized data excluded from audit
preconditions: Some records outside auditor’s scope
action_or_input: Auditor retrieves audit records
expected_result: Out-of-scope data excluded per BR-PSM-020

purpose: Verify financial report generation, export and logging
preconditions: Accounts Admin authorized; procurement/payment data exists
action_or_input: Select financial report, apply filters, generate and export
expected_result: Report generated from procurement/payment data per filters; export succeeds; generation logged

purpose: Verify unauthorized financial report access blocked
preconditions: User not authorized for selected report/data
action_or_input: Request financial report
expected_result: Access blocked; no report generated

purpose: Verify Department Head recommendation routes onward
preconditions: Indent routed to Department Head after Dept Admin review
action_or_input: Department Head reviews and records a recommendation
expected_result: Indent routed per BR-PSM-004; recommendation recorded; notifications sent

purpose: Verify recommending changes returns indent for modification
preconditions: Indent pending Department Head review
action_or_input: Department Head recommends changes to employee
expected_result: Indent returns to employee for modification via PSM-UC-023

purpose: Verify Department Head rejection requires justification
preconditions: Indent pending Department Head review
action_or_input: Reject with justification; also attempt without
expected_result: Rejection with justification recorded; without justification not accepted per BR-PSM-005

purpose: Verify Department Head can view authorized stock info without changing it
preconditions: Indent under Dept Head review; stock data available
action_or_input: Department Head opens stock view
expected_result: Authorized departmental/central availability and reservations displayed; no stock state changed

purpose: Verify behavior when stock information unavailable
preconditions: Stock data unavailable
action_or_input: Department Head opens stock view
expected_result: No current stock result available for reliance in the review; no business state changes

purpose: Verify vendor onboarding with complete GST/bank/compliance data results in verified vendor with version history and audit
preconditions: PS Admin authorized for vendor master
action_or_input: Create vendor record with valid GST details, bank details and compliance documents
expected_result: Vendor validated under BR-PSM-012 and recorded as verified/eligible; version history and audit record retained

purpose: Verify incomplete/invalid verification data leaves vendor unverified and blocked
preconditions: PS Admin authorized
action_or_input: Create vendor with missing/invalid GST or bank details or compliance docs
expected_result: Vendor remains unverified/ineligible; cannot be used for PO/payment

purpose: Verify previous version traceable after vendor update
preconditions: Existing vendor record
action_or_input: Update vendor master data
expected_result: New version saved; previous version remains traceable; audit recorded

purpose: Verify discrepancy case creation with evidence, linkage, resolution request and gating
preconditions: Delivery/GRN context exists; user is authorized receiving actor
action_or_input: Record discrepancy details with evidence and select return/replacement resolution
expected_result: Discrepancy case created and linked to receipt/indent/PO; PS Admin notified; unresolved discrepancy exposed to Accounts; final posting/payment gated

purpose: Verify partial discrepancy keeps accepted and discrepant portions separately traceable
preconditions: Only part of receipt is discrepant
action_or_input: Record discrepancy for the discrepant portion
expected_result: Accepted and discrepant portions separately traceable

purpose: Verify immediate resolution as accepted returns receipt to accepted path
preconditions: Discrepancy case open
action_or_input: Resolve the issue immediately as accepted
expected_result: Receipt returns to the accepted receipt path

purpose: Verify no case is created without authorization or delivery context (failure guarantee)
preconditions: User unauthorized, or no delivery context
action_or_input: Attempt to record a discrepancy
expected_result: No discrepancy case created

purpose: Verify transfer request created with source availability check and source notified
preconditions: Requesting user authorized; item/location records exist; source stock allocable
action_or_input: Create transfer request with source, destination and quantities
expected_result: Request recorded; source availability checked; prepared for source processing/reservation; source party notified

purpose: Verify request cannot proceed for unavailable quantity
preconditions: Source stock insufficient
action_or_input: Create transfer request exceeding source allocable stock
expected_result: Transfer cannot proceed for the unavailable quantity

purpose: Verify tender lifecycle from publication to committee selection and release for PO
preconditions: Indent approved; tender method applies
action_or_input: PS Admin publishes tender; bids submitted; Committee evaluates and records approval/selection
expected_result: Bids recorded; committee selection recorded; tender decision and records retained; selected vendor available for PO creation subject to vendor verification

purpose: Verify no vendor released when tender yields no approved selection
preconditions: Tender evaluated with no approved selection
action_or_input: Attempt to proceed to PO creation
expected_result: Tender remains unresolved/requires new tender action; no automatic retender; no vendor released for PO

purpose: Verify modification creates new version, retains prior version and re-routes
preconditions: Employee owns indent in modifiable state
action_or_input: Edit valid fields and submit modified version
expected_result: Prior version retained; new version created; modification logged; indent routed back through applicable review path

purpose: Verify editing blocked in non-modifiable state
preconditions: Indent in non-modifiable state
action_or_input: Employee selects Modify
expected_result: Editing blocked; no change

purpose: Verify failed validation prevents resubmission and preserves prior version
preconditions: Indent in modifiable state
action_or_input: Edit removing a mandatory field and submit
expected_result: Modified version not resubmitted; prior active version/state intact

purpose: Verify repeat creates new draft and separate new indent after submission, original unchanged
preconditions: Previous indent accessible to employee
action_or_input: Select Repeat/Reorder, change details, submit through UC-001
expected_result: Draft copied from previous indent; on submission new indent has its own ID and audit history; previous indent unchanged

purpose: Verify repeat unavailable for inaccessible indent
preconditions: Previous indent not accessible to employee
action_or_input: Attempt Repeat/Reorder
expected_result: Repeat not available; no new indent created; previous indent unchanged

purpose: Verify method determination and decision record, with Director/Registrar routing when required
preconditions: Indent approved/recommended for external procurement; stock insufficient; prior reviews done; value requires final review
action_or_input: PS Admin reviews indent and records procurement-method decision
expected_result: Direct/tender method determined per BR-PSM-008; decision and record saved; indent routed to Director/Registrar per BR-PSM-010

purpose: Verify indent proceeds to PO creation/tender when final review not required or already obtained
preconditions: Final review not required or already obtained
action_or_input: PS Admin records method decision
expected_result: Indent proceeds to direct PO creation or tender management as applicable

purpose: Verify execution blocked when required prior approval missing
preconditions: Required prior approval absent
action_or_input: PS Admin attempts to proceed with procurement
expected_result: Procurement execution blocked

purpose: Verify unverified selected vendor must be verified before PO issuance
preconditions: Selected vendor unverified
action_or_input: Attempt PO issuance
expected_result: PO issuance not allowed until vendor onboarding/verification completed

purpose: Verify PO created, linked and issued with status and audit
preconditions: Required approvals complete; verified vendor selected
action_or_input: PS Admin creates PO linked to indent and vendor, then issues it
expected_result: Approval and vendor verification verified; PO linked to indent and vendor; issued; status and audit history recorded

purpose: Verify PO creation/issuance blocked without required approval
preconditions: Required approval missing
action_or_input: Attempt to create/issue PO
expected_result: PO creation/issuance blocked; no PO issued

purpose: Verify PO issuance blocked for incompletely verified vendor
preconditions: Approvals complete; vendor verification incomplete
action_or_input: Attempt to issue PO
expected_result: PO issuance blocked per BR-PSM-012

purpose: Verify PO status/schedule update is timestamped, audited and alerts stakeholders
preconditions: PO exists; PS Admin authorized
action_or_input: Open PO and record status/delivery schedule update (e.g., dispatch event)
expected_result: Current status/schedule displayed; update recorded with timestamp and audit; relevant stakeholders alerted on dispatch/delivery event

purpose: Verify unauthorized PO update blocked
preconditions: User lacks authorization to update PO
action_or_input: Attempt to update PO status/schedule
expected_result: Update blocked; PO unchanged

purpose: Verify GRN creation for accepted goods
preconditions: Issue/PO exists; user authorized receiving actor
action_or_input: Inspect delivery and record full accepted quantities/condition
expected_result: GRN created/updated; receipt marked accepted subject to delivery confirmation; inspection recorded; stakeholders notified

purpose: Verify partial receipt records accepted quantity and leaves outstanding open
preconditions: Delivered quantity less than ordered
action_or_input: Record partial receipt
expected_result: Accepted received quantity recorded; outstanding quantity open per BR-PSM-022

purpose: Verify rejected/damaged/mismatched goods invoke discrepancy handling
preconditions: Goods damaged/mismatched
action_or_input: Record rejection in GRN
expected_result: Rejection/discrepancy recorded; PSM-UC-020 invoked; rejected quantity not posted

purpose: Verify eligible payment released with status, audit and alert
preconditions: Verified invoice; accepted GRN, delivery confirmation, verified vendor; no hold; user authorized
action_or_input: Accounts Admin records payment release for eligible (full or partial) amount
expected_result: Payment released for eligible amount; status and audit history recorded; payment-status alert sent

purpose: Verify payment placed/retained on hold with reason when condition unmet
preconditions: A required condition (e.g., delivery confirmation) not satisfied
action_or_input: Attempt payment processing
expected_result: Payment On Hold with recorded reason; not released

purpose: Verify unresolved invoice mismatch prevents release
preconditions: Invoice mismatch unresolved
action_or_input: Attempt payment release
expected_result: Release prevented per BR-PSM-018

purpose: Verify unverified vendor prevents release
preconditions: Vendor unverified
action_or_input: Attempt payment release
expected_result: Release prevented per BR-PSM-012

purpose: Verify dashboard shows status and metrics within user’s scope and permits navigation
preconditions: User authenticated with dashboard access
action_or_input: Open P&S dashboard and navigate to a permitted detail record
expected_result: Current process status and key metrics shown within authorized scope; navigation to permitted records works; no state change

purpose: Verify restricted data omitted from dashboard
preconditions: Data exists outside user’s role scope
action_or_input: Open dashboard
expected_result: Restricted data omitted per BR-PSM-020

purpose: Verify authorized scheduled-report definition is saved and active
preconditions: User authorized for report and scheduling
action_or_input: Select report, filters and schedule parameters; save
expected_result: Scheduled-report definition saved and confirmed active

purpose: Verify schedule not created for unauthorized user
preconditions: User not authorized for report or scheduling
action_or_input: Attempt to schedule report
expected_result: Schedule not created; no future execution established

purpose: Verify resolution of discrepancy case with vendor communication, adjustments and closure
preconditions: Open discrepancy case exists
action_or_input: PS Admin reviews evidence, records vendor communication and return/replacement resolution, applies adjustments
expected_result: Resolution and vendor communication recorded; inventory/accounting adjustments applied; resolution history recorded; case closed when resolved

purpose: Verify replacement must be inspected via GRN before full resolution
preconditions: Replacement delivered for open case
action_or_input: Attempt to treat case fully resolved before and after replacement inspection via UC-028
expected_result: Case not fully resolved until replacement inspected/recorded through PSM-UC-028

purpose: Verify invoice/payment hold remains while resolution pending
preconditions: Case pending; related invoice exists
action_or_input: Attempt payment/final posting while case open
expected_result: Hold remains effective; no final posting/payment

purpose: Verify transfer reserved, dispatched and destination notified
preconditions: Transfer request pending; source stock allocable; source user authorized
action_or_input: Source reviews request and records dispatch
expected_result: Transfer quantity reserved per BR-PSM-013; state updated to Dispatched; destination notified

purpose: Verify unavailable quantity cannot be dispatched
preconditions: Source stock insufficient
action_or_input: Attempt dispatch of full requested quantity
expected_result: Unavailable quantity cannot be dispatched; transfer remains unfulfilled for it

purpose: Verify receipt confirmation completes transfer and updates both ledgers with audit
preconditions: Transfer in Dispatched state
action_or_input: Destination Department Admin confirms receipt
expected_result: Transfer completed; source and destination ledgers updated per BR-PSM-027; completion audit entry recorded

purpose: Verify transfer stays open without completed ledger posting when receipt not confirmed
preconditions: Dispatched transfer; receipt cannot be confirmed
action_or_input: Do not confirm receipt
expected_result: Transfer remains open; no completed ledger posting

purpose: Verify scheduled report generated and logged when schedule becomes due
preconditions: Active authorized schedule with valid report definition and filters
action_or_input: Schedule becomes due
expected_result: Schedule/authorization validated; report generated with configured criteria; generation event logged; report available via authorized mechanism

purpose: Verify no report generated for disabled/unauthorized schedule and attempt is auditable
preconditions: Schedule disabled or no longer authorized
action_or_input: Schedule becomes due
expected_result: No report generated; blocked attempt auditable

purpose: Verify generation failure is logged and no success recorded
preconditions: Active schedule; report generation forced to fail
action_or_input: Schedule becomes due
expected_result: No successful generation recorded; failure logged for authorized follow-up
